title: An Empirical Evaluation of Message Delivery Reliability and Recovery Characteristics in Redis Streams and NATS JetStream
description: A reproducible empirical study of recovery policies, consumer concurrency, and publication/acknowledgment costs in Redis Streams 7.4.2/8.10.2 and NATS JetStream 2.10.24/2.15.0. Version 1.2.0 preserves the original evidence and adds three separately provisioned, fresh-store deployments on shared homelab hardware, matched publication durations, live recovery controls, driver-CPU sensitivity, synchronization traces, compression-policy diagnostics, and complete stored-payload readback for successful workloads. The package contains the main article and supplement, original and follow-up observations including failures, plans, pinned configurations and source references, deterministic analysis, conditional Lean models and homelab verification receipts, licenses, and document QA. It does not establish implementation correctness, equivalent durability contracts, tested power-loss durability, a universal broker ranking, or independent-host replication.
